title: About to use RPG Maker MZ, What should I know?

posts.author: Scion_of_the_Shadowlight
posts.body: I previously worked on RPG Maker FES on the 3ds and I noticed that MZ allowed for alot more customization and even had the resource pack from FES, so i decided to migrate the MZ, which i will be buying in a couple of days, is there anything I should know about it before I start?

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
You can download a free 30 day demo to see if you like it first. If you are going to buy it wait for a Steam sale, it goes on sale pretty much monthly.
Also depending on your reasons for getting MZ, MV might be a better option.

posts.author: Neppix_
posts.body:
Something I learned awhile after getting MZ and MV is that, despite it being an engine packed with loads of features you might still need to dabble into some code to edit things. So far I didn't need to edit much but having some JavaScript knowledge will definitely help a lot if you need something that you can't find from a plugin or online tutorial (You don't even need to be that knowledgable about coding! Idk much about js but I was still able to get a grip on what things did).
Despite that, plugins will still be your best friend and don't be afraid to use them! There's a lot of great plugins out there and if you need something specific I'm pretty sure there's a place to request plugins so don't be afraid to ask around!
TLDR; Plugins and JavaScript knowledge will be your best friend

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: The amount of javascript you need to know depends on how "customized" you want your game mechanics to be. The more you deviate from the stock engine the more plugins or custom scripting you'll need.
